facts.claim: Korea's Ministry of Justice has extended the temporary K-ETA exemption for 22 countries and regions (including the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Australia, New Zealand and Japan) to 31 December 2026; travellers without a K-ETA complete an arrival card instead.

sources.title: K-ETA: temporary exemption extended to 31 December 2026
VisitKorea: K-ETA exemption period extended until 2026

facts.note: Watch for a decision on 2027 in Q4 2026.

facts.claim: Korea refunds the VAT on room charges for up to 30 nights (breakfast included only if in the room rate; not service charges) to foreign individual tourists (not package groups) staying under 6 months and leaving within 3 months, at accommodation designated under the special provision; the culture ministry designates hotels quarterly.

sources.title: MCST: quarterly designation of hotels for the accommodation VAT refund
Newspim: 2026 tax reform proposal would end the scheme on 30 June 2027 (7 August 2026)

facts.note: The government's 2026 tax reform proposal moves the end date from 31 December 2028 to 30 June 2027; recheck when the National Assembly passes the bill.

facts.claim: Gimhae Airport limousine buses leave from platform 3, first floor, of both terminals and take credit cards only: to Haeundae/Gijang ₩9,500, first 07:10, last 21:40, about every 60 minutes, stopping at Park Hyatt Busan, Dongbaekseom entrance and Haeundae Beach; to Seomyeon/Bujeon ₩6,000, first 07:20, last 21:30, about every 70 minutes, stopping at Seomyeon Station (Lotte Hotel).
The Busan-Gimhae Light Rail Transit serves Gimhae Airport and connects with Busan Metro line 2 at Sasang and line 3 at Daejeo.

sources.title: Busan-Gimhae Light Rail Transit: directions with transfers

articles/where-to-stay-in-busan.html: meets the subway at Sasang, on line 2, and Daejeo, on line 3

facts.claim: The 21st Busan Fireworks Festival is on Saturday 7 November 2026 at Gwangalli Beach, Igidae and Dongbaekseom; paid seats are sold through NOL Ticket from 4 September 14:00 to 6 November 17:00.
facts.note: Programme times and road closures were not posted on 7 October 2026; add them if they appear.

facts.claim: Suyeong-gu runs the Gwangalli M Drone Light Show every Saturday evening over Gwangalli Beach with about 1,100 drones, at 19:00 and 21:00 from October to February.

sources.title: Busan Ilbo: the October 2026 shows (28 September 2026)

articles/where-to-stay-in-busan.html: at 7pm and 9pm from October to February

facts.note: Summer times (March to September) are later; recheck in March 2027.

sources.title: Signiel Busan: grand opening package, June–July 2020

facts.claim: The Westin Josun Busan stands between Haeundae Beach and Dongbaek Island (67 Dongbaek-ro).

articles/where-to-stay-in-busan.html: Between the western end of the beach and Dongbaek Island

facts.claim: Park Hyatt Busan is in Marine City (51 Marine City 1-ro), within walking distance of Haeundae Beach, and is a stop on the Gimhae Airport limousine to Haeundae.

articles/where-to-stay-in-busan.html: In Marine City, west of Dongbaek Island

articles/where-to-stay-in-busan.html: ten minutes' walk from exits 3 and 5 of Haeundae Station

articles/where-to-stay-in-busan.html: Standard rooms of 28 m² on the third to eighth floors

articles/where-to-stay-in-busan.html: About seven minutes' walk from Seomyeon Station
